mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_process_def WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT * ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_instance (proc_key, biz_type, biz_id, title, applicant_id, applicant_name, current_node, current_node_name, status, form_json) VALUES (#{procKey}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{title}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{currentNode}, #{currentNodeName}, #{status}, #{formJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM wf_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND i.status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task (instance_id, node_key, node_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, status) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeName}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET action=#{action}, comment=#{comment}, status='DONE', finish_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE wf_task SET status='CANCELED', finish_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'PENDING'
